artefact: pre-extracted contours of a band-quantised field
threshold_standing: PROVISIONAL, display-side. §16.7 rules the class and its keying and leaves widths and modulation terms to the implementation session (convention 5). The default is chosen against this run, whose peak SWE is an order of magnitude below reference -- see DEFAULT_THRESHOLD in the writing tool.

grid.coordinates: EPSG:5070 metres, [x0, y0, x1, y1, ...] per arc, rounded to the metre

extraction.why: §16.12.1. The crossing elevation is computable only from the 16 HUC4 band ladders, whose base elevations differ, so band 4 is a different 300 m under each parent. That ladder is the generator §16.12 keeps off the wire: a client holding it can evaluate the field anywhere in the region. Geometry ships; the per-node crossing elevations do not.
extraction.interpolation: linear between the two adjacent band MIDPOINTS the crossing falls between, then the level set of the DEM at that elevation -- §16.7's vertical interpolation on the uniform 300 m ruler
extraction.corridor: one band, 300 m. The crossing lies between the two midpoints by construction; `corridor_m` per day carries the measured distance to the nearer of them.

not_here.lattice_geometry: decision 890. A cell is contoured only when its four corners carry one node index, so no arc runs along a HUC10 divide. `boundary_crossings_not_drawn` counts the sign changes that fell there and were dropped.
not_here.days_not_listed: extraction is per day; only the requested days are here

payload.layout: x, y interleaved, EPSG:5070 metres. A day's arcs start at its `byte_offset` and run in the order of `arc_vertex_counts`.

_what: pre-extracted contour geometry. The band ladder it was extracted from is not here and is not derivable from it for any node whose arc is absent -- §16.12.
